title: Place Value
introduction: Explore place value through definitions, examples and practice.
definition: A digit's position determines its value. In a two-digit number, the left digit counts tens and the right digit counts ones.

exercises.question: What is the value of 6 in 63?
What number has 5 tens and 2 ones?
